title: Changelog - December 2015
content:
## Changelog - December 2015


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000093649

New Features

- You can now choose the font awesome icon you want to use for the 'Add To Favorites' button in Settings -> Design Settings -> Additional Design Settings -> Favorite Icon

- You can now choose the font size for the H1 and H2 of search results pages in Settings -> Design Settings > Additional Design Settings > Search Results H1 Size/ Search Results H2 Size

- You can now choose to hide the Google Map that displays on the member's profile page in Members -> Membership Levels > Display Tab > Hide Google Map on Profile

Enhancements / Fixes

- More Optimizations to code Infrastructure

- More than 70 bugs found and fixed ranging from Backend, Admin Panel, Frontend and more.
